name: Transfăgărășan
description: 90km of hairpins over the Făgăraș mountains, built in the 1970s on Ceaușescu's orders after Soviet tanks rolled into Czechoslovakia and he wanted a military road across the range. It tops out at 2,042m at Bâlea Lake.
getting: Drive it north to south for the better corners. It is shut by snow from roughly November to the end of June — check before you commit to a route. Allow half a day, not two hours.
